name: Nexus Fulcrum Lateral
monitor_reason: No pipeline sponsor, length, or route is identified for the lateral itself, and it cannot be told apart from the Tahoe Reno Industrial Center spur of the Great Basin 2028 Expansion (P7860). The only concrete step is a power plant application, not a pipeline filing. No data center tie is stated for the pipe.
researcher_notes: A June 2026 New Project Media article says Nexus Fulcrum LLC applied on June 17 to the Public Utilities Commission of Nevada for a 510 MW gas plant at the former Fulcrum BioEnergy site in the Tahoe Reno Industrial Center, Storey County. It says gas would come through a new lateral connecting to the Great Basin Pipeline system. It also says the plant would serve one customer in the park and support expanded development there, including data centers. The article does not give the lateral's length, route, owner, or diameter, and says the developer and its link to Switch are unclear. A June 2026 Hoodline article describes the Great Basin 2028 Expansion, filed at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, which includes a spur into the same industrial center. Hoodline is low weight and cites the wrong docket. It is not known whether the plant lateral is that spur, a separate line, or a short in-fence connection. The existing row P7860 already covers the spur. Data center field left blank because no source ties this specific pipe to a data center. Re-check when the Nevada commission docket or Great Basin filings state the lateral's length and owner.
